messages:
olivia: Hey sec team — need a short (30m) admin window to access the S3-backed terraform state for prod to clear a stale lock. Blocked deploy and a customer-facing fix is stuck. Plan: `terraform force-unlock <LOCK_ID>` then apply a one-line provider pin. ETA tonight 22:30 UTC. Requesting ephemeral console role `infra-admin` and guidance on log redaction.
security-bot: Reminder: fill the break-glass form (https://redwood.tools/break-glass) with justification, start/end times, and list of principals. Tokens will have MFA + session recording enabled.
mike: can we do the same flow in staging first? also who else needs access?
olivia: did the exact steps in staging earlier today, succeeded. Only me + jordan to confirm after unlock.
ash: prefer to limit to 15m if possible. Make sure audit logging is on and S3 object versioning is preserved before any state change.
jordan: I can be present to supervise. I approve conditional on: (1) session recording on, (2) operators limited to olivia+jordan, (3) rotate any creds used after. I'll join the 22:30 UTC call.
anne: note on redaction — if you need to pull logs for troubleshooting, redact emails and customer IDs before uploading. Use the `redact-logs` script in infra-tools: `./redact-logs --strip-emails --mask-ids <logfile>` and upload to `s3://redwood-secure/incident-uploads/`.
mike: please paste the exact terraform command you plan to run so we can pre-approve the action.
olivia: command will be:
```
terraform force-unlock -force LOCK_ID
terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.provider_pin
```
security-bot: Temporary elevation checklist: break-glass form submitted, justification present, participants verified, session recording enabled. Post-action upload: redacted logs + short postmortem in #postmortems within 24h.
olivia: submitted the form just now (link in form). Start: 1719877800 (22:30 UTC). Duration requested: 00:30. Owner for postmortem: olivia.
jordan: :thumbsup: I'll create a backup of the tfstate object BEFORE unlock: `aws s3 cp s3://tfstate/prod.tfstate s3://tfstate/backups/prod.tfstate.bak --sse aws:kms`.
anne: approved from security side as long as backup and redaction steps are followed. Keep copies only in secure bucket and tag accordingly.
security-bot: Approved by security (approval_id=TG-789). Elevation will be provisioned at start time for olivia+jordan, TTL 01:00. Remember to run redact-logs if you export anything. Good luck.
olivia: thanks all — will post a short status update in this thread when done.
